serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Knowtex is an AI assistant that supports federal clinicians before, during, and after every patient visit. Before the visit, it prepares the clinician with relevant patient history and context. During the visit, it listens ambiently with the patient's consent so the clinician can stay focused on the patient. After the visit, it automates complex medical workflows and completes clinician-approved work directly in the agency's electronic health record. Throughout, Knowtex surfaces clinical insights that help clinicians make informed decisions. Clinicians can use Knowtex on the web, on Windows desktop, and on mobile, and it keeps working offline.

Knowtex runs in AWS GovCloud (US-East), serves government customers only, processes protected health information, and is categorized at the FedRAMP Moderate impact level.

**Overall FIPS 199 categorization:** Moderate (Confidentiality: Moderate, Integrity: Moderate, Availability: Moderate). All listed services are categorized as Moderate for confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Knowtex Trust Center with security policies, compliance reports, and FedRAMP certification materials.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Request access to restricted documents through the Trust Center, or email privacy@knowtex.ai.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Reviews patient history and prepares the clinician before the visit.
Listens to the clinical conversation through web, Windows desktop, and mobile apps, including offline.
Automates post-visit clinical and administrative work for clinician review and approval.
Surfaces relevant clinical information and insights to support the clinician.
Completes clinician-approved work in the agency's electronic health record.
Lets authorized administrators manage users, access, and settings.

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US) us-gov-east-1 provides the underlying IaaS infrastructure; Knowtex inherits controls as a leveraged authorization.

nonCertified.name: DuploCloud
nonCertified.useCase: Infrastructure provisioning and DevSecOps automation for the Knowtex environment in AWS GovCloud.
